description: Finds a song on YouTube: up to 3 matching videos (id, title, thumbnail). Use the returned video ids in create_playlist, add_songs and update_playlist instead of the song's name, so it isn't looked up again. Each search not seen before uses up song lookups (limited per hour), so search only for songs you need.

query.description: What to search for, ideally "Artist - Title"

name: search_songs

id.description: YouTube video id: reuse it instead of the title

title: Search songs
